description: Implementation of the mac_cell_processor class handling MAC layer processing, scheduling, UE management, and PDU handling in a 5G NR context.

classes.name: mac_cell_processor
classes.description: Handles MAC layer processing, scheduling, UE management, and PDU handling for a 5G NR cell.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Activates the MAC cell processor, notifying scheduler and setting cell state to active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Deactivates the MAC cell processor, stopping scheduling and clearing resources.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the cell with new system info, SI PDUs, or slice reconfiguration requests.

methods.name: handle_slot_indication
methods.description: Processes slot timing indications, scheduling, and MAC PDU handling for a slot.

methods.name: handle_error_indication
methods.description: Handles error events for a slot.

methods.name: handle_stop_indication
methods.description: Handles stop indication, signaling cell stop completion.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE to the cell, allocating resources and creating UE context.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the cell, deallocating resources.

methods.name: addmod_bearers
methods.description: Adds or modifies bearers for a UE.

methods.name: handle_slot_indication_impl
methods.description: Internal implementation for processing slot indications, scheduling, and PDU handling.

methods.name: encode_dci
methods.description: Encodes DL or UL DCI messages based on their type.

methods.name: assemble_dl_sched_request
methods.description: Assembles downlink scheduling request to PHY.

methods.name: assemble_dl_data_request
methods.description: Assembles downlink data request including SIBs, RARs, and PDUs.

methods.name: update_logical_channel_dl_buffer_states
methods.description: Updates DL buffer states for logical channels based on scheduling results.

methods.name: write_tx_pdu_pcap
methods.description: Writes transmitted PDUs to PCAP for debugging or analysis.
